Prism and its bundled dependencies, taken from prismatoid 0.17.3 (PyPI, manylinux_2_34_x86_64).

libprism.so differs from the wheel's copy in one byte range: DT_RUNPATH
was shortened from $ORIGIN/../../prismatoid.libs to $ORIGIN so that the
libraries can sit beside it instead of in a Python package layout. No
code was changed.
